subject: Post-call: Private VPC / on-prem architecture review & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call: Private VPC / on-prem architecture review & next steps

Hi Sarah -

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through Acme Health's objectives and constraints. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps:

Summary from discovery:
- Goal: Private/on-prem deployment for PHI workloads with strict network isolation and KMS integration.
- Drivers: data residency, auditability, and predictable latency for real-time triage workflows.
- Current infra: Azure-based VNet with on-prem data center connected via ExpressRoute; existing firewall managed by Acme networking team.
- Open items: KMS/HSM provider, roster of technical attendees for architecture review, expected QPS / concurrency, and maintenance window constraints.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Architecture review (technical deep dive) with your network/security/infra team + our SEs to go through VPC/VNet topologies, firewall rules, IP allowlists, KMS options, and deployment model (VPC vs on-prem appliance). Estimated 60-90 minutes.
2) Share Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a lightweight checklist of items we'll want before the call.
3) Schedule the architecture review - availability below. Please pick what works for you or share alternatives.

Possible time slots (PT):
- Wed Jul 22, 10:00-11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 23, 14:00-15:30 PT
- Mon Jul 27, 09:00-10:30 PT

Attendees we suggest from our side: Michael Grant (Solutions Engineer) - technical lead, Neha Kapoor (Customer Success) - onboarding/ops. If you can confirm your network/security contacts (and their preferred email addresses) we will include them on the invite.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and our private deployment checklist for review. If you prefer a shorter sync just to align on compatibility before a full deep dive, we can do that too - let me know.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (mutual_action_plan, 1 page)
Attachment: private-deploy-checklist.pdf (checklist, 2 pages)

Proposed agenda (60-75 mins):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5 mins)
2) High-level deployment options: VPC-hosted vs on-prem appliance (10 mins)
